plan: (Set EITHER planPath OR plan, not both — if both are present, planPath wins. planPath should be the FULL ABSOLUTE path of the plan-mode file (the engine does not expand ~), e.g. C:/Users/you/.claude/plans/<name>.md — no copy needed; agents read it VERBATIM. ALTERNATIVE to planPath: paste the approved plan markdown here as a string. Flow: the orchestrating agent authors the plan in PLAN MODE (EnterPlanMode → plan mode's own ~/.claude/plans/<name>.md), the user approves it (ExitPlanMode), then the agent runs the MANDATORY phase:"refine" with planPath pointing at that file (after approval — refine reviews the approved plan and returns its gaps/questions; run it before the writing phase:"build"), reusing this SAME runId + planPath throughout. See CLAUDE.md for the canonical flow + the section shape: ## Feature / ## Acceptance Criteria / ## Integration Points / ## Implementation Steps / ## Files / ## Test Strategy / ## Gate.)
conventions: Coding conventions the DEVELOPER follows (the blind code reviewer is NOT shown these): language/version constraints, what stays additive, style, and what NOT to touch (legacy business logic).

gates.build: SHELL COMMAND that compiles/lints — a non-zero exit code means FAIL (this gate must ALWAYS pass)
gates.test: SHELL COMMAND that runs the test suite
gates.testSetup: Notes for authoring + running tests: how to scope a single test, runner quirks, run-as-user / container exec prefix, fixtures/DB isolation, or how to start a server for curl/MCP verification.
